tools.name: get_character
tools.description: The fixed description of Mila Zima: face, figure, hair, ring, colours, voice, wardrobe, and the reference pictures to give an image model. Read this before generating her.

tools.name: get_rules
tools.description: What Mila Zima will not do, the words to keep out of prompts, and the terms: fan use is free with an AI label, commercial use needs permission.

tools.name: build_prompt
tools.description: Returns a ready prompt with her fixed description filled in, the reference pictures to attach and how to use it. It only writes text; it does not generate anything.

tools.name: check_prompt
tools.description: Finds words and scenes that break her rules or pull the picture away from her look.

tools.name: list_pictures
tools.description: The published pictures of her latest look, with direct addresses, sizes and descriptions.

tools.name: list_songs
tools.description: Her released songs and where to hear them, plus the style text for making a demo in her sound.

tools.name: list_films
tools.description: Her music films: page, YouTube address, film file, length, number of shots.

tools.name: get_film_shots
tools.description: Every shot of one film in order. With "shot" it returns how that shot was made: the model, what it was given, what it cost.
